case_number: 2024 INSC 834; Criminal Appeal No. of 2024 (Arising out of SLP (Crl.) No.1242 of 2021)
summary: Maintainability of second complaint after acceptance of negative Final Report under Section 173 CrPC; no bar under Section 300(1) CrPC as no prior trial/acquittal; Bhagwat Singh precedent on Magistrate's courses with negative report; Abhinandan Jha doctrine permitting protest petition conversion to complaint; rejection of autrefois acquit argument; second complaint allowed despite prior negative report
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; setting aside High Court's dismissal of revision petition; upholding second complaint's maintainability; remanding for fresh consideration of cognizance
